text:
GameStop is charging fifteen hundred dollars for a used PS Five Pro. Thanks, GTA 6.

In twenty twenty-four, the PS Five Pro launched at seven hundred dollars. Then seven fifty. Today, a brand-new one costs nine hundred.

But a leaked GameStop memo shows used ones at up to fifteen hundred. Used. And staff were told the price is intentional.

That's six hundred dollars more than a new one. And GameStop reportedly pays around eight hundred when you trade one in.

Why? GTA 6 comes out November nineteenth, and the PS Five Pro is sold out almost everywhere in the U.S.

The good news? Sony just gave the regular PS Five a new AI upscaler called QSSR. If Rockstar uses it, GTA 6 could look sharper without the Pro.

Add the eighty dollar game, and that Pro setup costs almost sixteen hundred dollars.

Heads up: this comes from a leaked memo, not an official announcement.

Would you pay fifteen hundred dollars to play GTA 6 on a Pro? Tell me below.
